case_number: 2025 INSC 327; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO._______________ OF 2025 (@Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No.16893 of 2024)
summary: Preventive detention challenge under COFEPOSA; non-application of mind alleged in omnibus use of Section 3(1)(i)-(iv) clauses; habitual smuggling syndicate leadership; smuggling, abetting, concealing, dealing established; gold smuggling from Dubai via carriers; habitual offender affecting national economy; no procedural defects; non-consideration of pending bail cancellation application; no live link with NDPS conviction; proviso under Section 3(1) prohibits COFEPOSA use where NDPS applies; detention upheld upon factual satisfaction.
legal_provisions_cited: Constitution of India, 1951 Art.14, Art.19, Art.21
Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
final_judgment: Detention upheld; appeal dismissed; no relief granted to detenu.
